plugin_description: CADRER, the six-step build loop: ideate, refine, spec, slice, implement, audit. One skill per step; each writes one file into the build folder and hands it to the next. Commands and files in English.

vocab.language_line: Answer, and write the files' contents, in English; file names and headings stay as written here.

ideate.description: Choisir — ideate. Use when someone brings a problem, an annoyance, or a vague app idea and has not yet decided what to build. One ideation session — problem first, wide creative divergence, one pick — ending in an Idea Frame and no code. Not for planning, specifying or building something already decided.

refine.description: Affiner — refine. Use after an Idea Frame exists and before any spec. Interviews the person one question at a time until every decision behind the idea is settled or knowingly left open, then writes the decisions down. Never builds, never specs.

spec.description: Détailler — spec. Use after the decisions are settled and before any slices. Turns the Idea Frame and the decisions into one spec — synthesis only, no interview. Never builds.

slice.description: Répartir — slice. Use after the spec exists and before any code. Cuts the spec into tracer-bullet slices, each saying what blocks it. Never builds.

implement.description: Exécuter — implement. Use after the slices exist. Builds exactly one slice — the one named, else the next whose blockers are done — runs it, ticks its Done-when boxes, commits. One slice per window; open slices can run in parallel, one window each.

audit.description: Réviser — audit. Use after the implement skill finished a slice and before it is merged or the next slice starts. Audits the slice's changes on two axes — does it do what the slice and spec asked, is the code sound — in read-only sub-agents, and writes an audit with a verdict. Never fixes code, never merges.
